dct_description_sm: Cartographic Details: Scale [1: 6,900,000]. Imprint derived from the atlas in which the map was issued."J. & G. Menzies sculp." Inset map:"Isle of Ceylon" ; scale [1: 4,500,000]. Shows boundaries, rivers and principal settlements. Relief shown pictorially. Greenwich meridian.
